pr_title: run: reconnect if our dbus connection is terminated
pr_body:
We must be prepared that systemd temporarily drops off the bus or disconnects our direct connections (due to systemctl daemon-reexec or so). Hence automatically reconnect when we watch the unit status, and handle this case gracefully.

Fixes: #32906
Fixes: #27204
